VICR.headline: Company News for Sep 23, 2026
VICR.description: Several companies reported earnings results with mixed outcomes. AutoZone beat earnings expectations and gained 3.3%, while THOR Industries surpassed revenue estimates with a 5.6% jump. MillerKnoll missed revenue targets and declined slightly. Vicor Corporation surged 19.9% after raising its third-quarter revenue growth outlook to over 20%.

VICR.headline: Earnings Estimates Rising for Vicor (VICR): Will It Gain?
VICR.description: Vicor (VICR), a modular power components company, is positioned as a solid investment choice due to remarkably improving earnings outlook and upward analyst estimate revisions. The company carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, with current-quarter earnings expected to grow 38.1% year-over-year and full-year earnings projected at 38.1% growth. The stock has gained 17.9% over the past four weeks, reflecting investor confidence in its earnings prospects.

VKTX.headline: Can Novo's Rare Disease Pipeline Add a New Growth Pillar Beyond GLP-1?
VKTX.description: Novo Nordisk received positive regulatory recommendations in Europe for Frehemgo (hemophilia A treatment) and Sogroya (growth hormone therapy for multiple indications), potentially diversifying revenue beyond its pressured GLP-1 portfolio. However, the company faces intensifying competition from Eli Lilly's blockbuster GLP-1 drugs and smaller biotechs, with Novo's stock underperforming the industry year-to-date.

VKTX.headline: Why Viking Therapeutics Stock Skyrocketed on Tuesday
VKTX.description: Viking Therapeutics' stock surged 35.67% after announcing positive clinical trial results for its obesity drug VK2735. Participants lost 16-19% of body weight over 21 weeks and maintained up to 97% of weight loss with flexible dosing schedules. The drug showed strong tolerability with low discontinuation rates, positioning Viking as a potential challenger in the rapidly expanding obesity drug market projected to reach $150 billion by 2035.

ALAB.headline: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Astera Labs, SpaceX, Cloudflare, NVIDIA and Meta Platforms
ALAB.description: Zacks highlights Astera Labs as a Zacks Rank #1 Strong Buy, emphasizing its role as an essential connectivity chip provider for AI data centers. The company has demonstrated triple-digit earnings and revenue growth since 2024 and has beaten analyst expectations every quarter since its IPO. Investor Gavin Baker supports the thesis that Astera Labs provides irreplaceable bottleneck assets as hyperscalers develop custom silicon and AI infrastructure scales toward larger rack-based systems.
